newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary cen bank cuts four repo rates by 0.25 pct.
newsitem.headline: Hungary cen bank cuts four repo rates by 0.25 pct.

text.p: The National Bank of Hungary (NBH) reduced four of its five repo rates by 0.25 percentage points each, the NBH said on its Reuters page NBHI on Monday.
The NBH cut both the overnight and one-week repo rates to 28.5 percent, it said.
The one-week reverse repo rate was lowered to 22.5 percent, while its one-month reverse repo rate to 23.0 percent, it said.
The central bank left its overnight reverse repo rate unchanged at 17.50 percent, it said.
The central bank last cut the same four repo rates by 0.25 percentage points on September 16.
